summaries.2026001763-day-2@1: The patient was kept on NPO with PNSS 1 L x 100 cc/hr, octreotide drip (500 mcg in 95 cc PNSS) at 10 cc/hr (50 mcg/hr), TPN 1400 kcal over 36 hours at 50 cc/hr and KCl drip at 4 mEq/hr (10 cc/hr). CBC and BUN, CBG q6h, 2D echo, fecalysis with FOBT, lipid profile, FBS and blood typing were requested, blood CS x 2 sites was extracted, and the WAB CT scan with IV contrast stayed on hold. Repeat HD was planned with a low-flux dialyzer for 4 hours, BFR 180-200, DFR 400, NSS flushing, UF 1 L net and CBG q1h. Piperacillin-tazobactam 2.25 g IV q6h with 0.75 g IV after every HD, pantoprazole (Amphoter) 40 mg IV OD, paracetamol 300 mg IV q6h PRN for fever or pain and NAC 1.2 g IV q12h were continued, with calcium gluconate drips held. Adenosine 3 mg SIVP was given, reassessed after 15 minutes (maximum 12 mg/day). Enoxaparin 0.6 SC OD was planned if there were no surgical plans, with a CVP target of 8-10 mmHg.
summaries.2026001763-day-5@3: The patient was kept on NPO with TPN at 53 cc/hr, PNSS 1 L x 60 cc/hr, amiodarone drip at 10.4 ml/hr and fentanyl drip at 10 ml/hr, with norepinephrine and dobutamine off. Pancreatic clysis PNSS 1 L x 8 hours was continued, Bogota bag placement under anesthesia with intra-op monitoring was scheduled, and repeat hemoperfusion was planned. CBG q4h with D50/50 1 vial for CBG below 100 and V-SIMV at FiO2 40%, TV 370, Tinsp 0.75, flow 40, PS 20, PEEP 5 were continued. Vancomycin 1 g in 100 cc PNSS over 2 hours q48h, piperacillin-tazobactam 2.25 g IV q6h with 0.75 g IV after every HD and pantoprazole (Amphoter) 40 mg IV q12h were continued. The fentanyl drip of 100 mcg in 100 cc PNSS titrated by 5 mcg/hr, fentanyl 10 mcg IV q15 minutes PRN for moderate to severe pain (maximum 3 rescues/hr) and paracetamol 600 mg IV q6h PRN for pain or fever were continued. Adenosine 3 mg SIVP (maximum 12 mg/day), albumin 1 vial plus furosemide 40 mg OD on non-HD days and NAC 1.2 g IV q12h were continued, with a CVP target of 8-10 mmHg. Furosemide 40 mg IV was given, and the 3rd and last hemoperfusion was ordered with HA 330, rinsed and primed with PNSS 1 L each, at BFR 150-180. HP was followed by HD for 4 hours at BFR 200-250, DFR 400-500, NSS flushing, UF 1 L net, albumin over 2 hours and CBG q1h, with repeat BUN, creatinine, Na and K in the AM.
summaries.2026001763-day-10@4: PNSS 1 L x 40 cc/hr was put on hold, with TPN at 53 cc/hr, the fentanyl drip at 25 mcg/hr, the amiodarone drip at 10.42 cc/hr and jejunostomy feeding at 900 kcal/day (100 cc q4h). Lidocaine 1-2 throat sprays q8h, NAC 1.2 g IV q12h and pantoprazole 40 mg IV q8h were continued. After wound care, JP drains were kept at negative pressure.
summaries.2026001763-day-12@2: Jejunostomy feeding at 900 kcal/day (100 cc q4h) and fentanyl drip at 25 mcg/hr were continued, with PLRS 1 L on hold and amiodarone off. Coralan 5 mg 1/2 tab q12h, trimetazidine (Vestar) 35 mg 1 tab q8h, EPO 5000 units SC 3 times a week, NAC 1.2 g IV q12h and albumin 1 vial plus furosemide 40 mg OD on non-HD days were continued, with HD scheduled for the day. After wound care, about 200 cc was drained from the Bogota bag and change of the JP drain bulbs was planned. PLRS 1 L at 60 cc/hr was run.
summaries.2026001960-day-2@3: A sterile measuring tape was prepared, or a measuring tape soaked in alcohol or Sterilium if none was available. PNSS 1 L x 40 cc/hr and Nutribest 6 scoops in 300 ml water 5 times a day with 150 cc flushing were continued. Lumbar puncture was scheduled for the day, with CBG taken during the tap, opening and closing CSF pressures, and CSF sent for cell and differential count, GS/CS, protein and glucose, fungal CS and cryptococcal antigen latex agglutination, with a specimen saved for possible BioFire. For possible CNS infection versus abscess, dexamethasone 4 mg IV was given now then q8h. Mannitol 150 ml q4h, levetiracetam 500 mg 1 tab BID, Neuroaid 2 caps TID and pantoprazole 40 mg 1 tab OD were continued while the CSF results and the cranial CT scan with contrast were awaited.
summaries.2026001960-day-9@1: Baclofen 10 mg 1 tab was revised to TID.
summaries.2026001960-day-12@4: PNSS 1 L x 40 cc/hr, Nutribest 6 scoops in 300 ml water 5 times a day with 150 cc flushing and CBG OD were continued, with repeat creatinine planned. summaries.2026001982-day-1@2: A 12-lead ECG was requested for tachycardia, and Surgicel packing was maintained.

summaries.2026001982-day-10@5: Pantoprazole 40 mg IV was given. STAT CBC and portable CXR were requested and ranitidine 50 mg IV was given. summaries.2026001982-day-11@3: CBC was added to the AM labs and furosemide 20 mg IV was given after the pRBC transfusion. Hydrocortisone 50 mg IV q6h was given. For CBG 64 mg/dL, D50/50 1 vial was given, and the IVF to follow was D5NSS 1 L x 60 cc/hr, at 40 cc/hr during transfusion.
summaries.2026002008-day-2@4: An IFC was inserted for bladder distention and accurate I&O monitoring. Paracetamol 300 mg IV was given for 10/10 inguinal pain, with referral if the pain persisted. IVF was increased to 120 cc/hr for 4 hours then reassessed, and Neurology requested GUSS testing.
summaries.2026002008-day-9@2: Lactulose was decreased to 30 cc ODHS PRN for no BM. Serum sodium was repeated now, again that evening, then twice daily.
summaries.2026002021-day-1@3: The patient was admitted under Medical Oncology with vital signs q4h, I&O every shift, CBR with bathroom privileges, and a full diet with no raw fruits or vegetables and no red meat. For pancreatic cancer, CBC, creatinine, SGOT, SGPT, total bilirubin, Na, K, iCa, albumin and a 12-lead ECG were requested, PNSS 1 L at KVO was started, and baseline weight, height and vital signs were taken. Paracetamol 600 mg IV was given. Blood typing and a plain abdominal x-ray were requested, pantoprazole 40 mg IV was started now then OD, and fentanyl 12.5 mg IV q1h was started. Strict I&O was recorded quantitatively, with referral for any recurrence of melena.
summaries.2026002021-day-5@6: Ceftriaxone 2 g IV OD was ordered, and furosemide 20 mg IV was given with the post-furosemide output relayed. Repeat CBC, procalcitonin, urine GS/CS and blood CS x 2 sites were planned. After a reaction to the ceftriaxone skin test, ceftriaxone was shifted to ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q12h, with paracetamol 600 mg IV q6h PRN for fever (T above 37.8 C). Cultures were taken before antibiotics were started. Once available, the oxycodone drip was to be shifted to morphine plain 10 mg 1 tab q6h RTC, with 1 tab q4h PRN for moderate to severe pain, and the oxycodone drip was continued at the current rate until then. Ciprofloxacin was shifted to piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 g IV now then q6h and IVF was increased to 100 cc/hr. Hydration was then increased to 120 cc/hr for 5 hours and reassessed.
summaries.2026002021-day-6@2: The present pain management was continued.
